channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que, se eleito, acabará com facções criminosas em um ano: 'Se fizer isso, eu terei tido sucesso'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, stated that if elected, he will eliminate criminal factions in Brazil within one year using tough measures and enemy criminal law. He called it humiliating that the U.S. classifies these groups as terrorists and argued Brazil must act on its own sovereignty, while accepting international cooperation — especially with the U.S. and the Netherlands — through intelligence sharing.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a ser atendido por dentista, sob condição de sigilo da consulta
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to attend a dental appointment, provided the date and time remain confidential. The ruling aims to ensure security and privacy for Bolsonaro, who remains under precautionary measures. The dental visit took place on Monday, the 17th, as authorized by the justice.

item.title: Após reaproximação, Alcolumbre e Lula trocam afagos em evento da Petrobras no Amapá
item.description: President Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre exchanged public praise during a Petrobras event in Amapá, signaling their political reconciliation after a rift caused by the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. Alcolumbre defended Brazil’s sovereignty in offshore oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin, while Lula commended Alcolumbre for advancing key government priorities in the Senate, including the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, the Public Security PEC, and the critical minerals bill.

item.title: Saúde de Lula está “impecável”, diz presidente do PT
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 80, has 'impeccable' health, emphasizing his daily physical activity and better condition than when he took office in 2003. He downplayed concerns about Lula's history of scalp basal cell carcinoma, noting the lesion was removed and that hat use stems from radiotherapy, which is common in Brazil. Lula removed his hat and bowed to the public during a speech in São Bernardo do Campo, reinforcing transparency about his treatment.

item.title: PT diz que irá aprimorar plano de governo de Lula durante campanha
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, said that Lula's government plan will be refined during the campaign, emphasizing that the 84-page document presented on August 7 is an initial point and that themes such as sovereignty, combating organized crime, energy transition, and political reform will be deepened. He clarified that the official presentation of the program will occur soon, with Lula highlighting the central axes in speeches.

item.title: PT diz que vai começar a negociar apoio do Centrão no 1º turno
item.description: The PT will begin negotiating with Centrão parties starting August 17, 2026, to broaden support for Lula in the first round, even after convention deadlines. The party already has alliances with seven left-wing parties and supports candidates in 27 states, aiming to attract center and center-right factions from parties like PSD, MDB, PP, and União Brasil, which already have state-level agreements with the PT. The PT will reduce vice-presidential candidacies from 9 to 6 and maintains 19 own Senate candidacies, while backing candidates from 9 other parties.

item.title: Ordem da propaganda eleitoral de São Paulo na TV e no rádio é definida pelo TRE; confira
item.description: The TRE-SP determined the order of free electoral propaganda for the 2026 São Paulo elections, with the coalition 'Coragem Para Seguir Avançando', led by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, being the first to appear in the state government slot. The first-round propaganda will run from August 28 to October 1, featuring 50 daily minutes in blocks and 70 minutes in insertions. Candidacies from PCB, PCO, Agir, PSTU, and UP will not receive free airtime due to the performance clause.

item.title: Caiado: Lula quer desviar atenção para tarifaço para não falar de endividamento
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate and former governor of Goiás, accused President Lula of using the 'tariff hike' narrative in trade negotiations with the United States as a tactic to divert attention from the rising indebtedness of the population and businesses. Caiado claimed Lula is attempting to 'deceive the voter' by emphasizing sovereignty and tariffs to avoid discussing the financial crisis affecting Brazilians.

item.title: PT vai buscar alianças com o Centrão já no 1º turno, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: The national president of the PT, Edinho Silva, stated that the party will seek alliances with the Centrão already in the first round of the 2026 elections, regardless of past political positions. The statement was made after the deadline for candidacy registration ended, confirming Lula as the sole presidential candidate with support from other parties. Edinho stressed the need for dialogue with all democratic forces to build a broad front around Lula's candidacy.

item.title: Alcolumbre se acerca de Lula com ajuda de Moraes, para que os três continuem fortes
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is moving closer to Lula, mediated by Alexandre de Moraes, to secure his 2027 re-election and shield himself from PF investigations into the secret budget and Amapá. He controls over R$1.2 billion in Amapá amendments and fears the criminalization of politics, seeking strategic alliances to maintain power. The rapprochement stems from his fear of being seen as 'old politics' if he loses influence in a potentially Bolsonaro-dominated Senate.

item.title: Garantimos soberania energética, diz Silveira sobre Margem Equatorial
item.description: Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira stated that the oil discovery in the Equatorial Margin ensures Brazil's energy sovereignty, emphasizing the country will not relinquish exploration of the resource, which holds at least 41 million barrels according to government estimates. He made the remarks during a public visit to the site in Oiapoque, Amapá, alongside President Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre, highlighting the importance of national wealth in fighting poverty and promoting development. Petrobras confirmed the presence of hydrocarbons but has not yet determined the economic viability of exploitation.

item.title: Caiado vê “colapso do varejo” e cita recuperação da Casas Bahia
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), presidential candidate, stated that Brazil is experiencing a 'retail collapse', citing Casas Bahia's judicial recovery request as evidence. He linked the crisis to high interest rates (14%), household indebtedness, and criticized the Desenrola program for not addressing root causes, advocating for fiscal adjustment instead.

item.title: Marcelinho, Luís Fabiano e Edmundo lideram patrimônio entre boleiros
item.description: Marcelinho Carioca leads in declared wealth among former Brazilian football players running in the 2026 elections, with R$ 45.4 million, followed by Luís Fabiano (R$ 20.1 million) and Edmundo (R$ 16 million). The eight candidates include former strikers, midfielders, and a Flamengo executive, running for district deputy, federal deputy, and state governor.

item.title: Mendonça manda redes tirarem do ar vídeo com deepfake de Flávio
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ordered X and TikTok to remove within 24 hours a deepfake video falsely attributing offensive statements to Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar, PL’s presidential and vice-presidential candidates. The ruling, granted as an urgent injunction, deems the content as illegal early negative electoral propaganda and prohibits the use of deepfakes without disclosure. The PL claims the video harms the candidates’ reputations and spreads known falsehoods.

item.title: Moraes decide local para atendimento odontológico de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized dental treatment for former President Jair Bolsonaro, but required the appointment to take place at the Military Police Medical Center in the Federal District. The defense had requested that Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Flávio Bolsonaro, serve as the treating dentist.

item.title: Lula quer apuração de denúncias contra Lulinha e Marcola
item.description: President Lula called for a full investigation into all allegations involving his son, Fábio Luís da Silva (Lulinha), and former aide Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), stating he will not interfere in probes. The allegations include payments from Roberta Luchsinger, implicated in INSS fraud schemes, and messages referencing 'the future of the two is Switzerland'.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja os números das candidaturas oficializadas
item.description: The 2026 general elections have 20,506 candidacy registration requests, 8,700 fewer than in 2022. The highest competition is for district deputy (17.5 candidates per seat) and federal deputy (14.87 per seat). There are 13 presidential candidacies, including the re-election ticket of Lula (PT) and Alckmin (PSB).

item.title: Cury diz que Brasil já é parlamentarista e cita Tarcísio como premier
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) stated that Brazil already functions as a parliamentary system in practice, advocating for semipresidentialism. He proposed that Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) could serve as prime minister, with the president retaining control over strategic areas such as the Armed Forces and foreign policy. Cury argued the model would allow for the easy removal of an unpopular, corrupt, or inefficient prime minister without presidential impeachment.

item.title: Em agenda no SCS, Grass promete políticas para moradores de rua
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT), candidate for Governor of the Federal District, walked through the Setor Comercial Sul (SCS) in Brasília, speaking with merchants, street vendors, and people experiencing homelessness. He pledged to implement specific public policies to support this population, focusing on employment, mental health, and shelter, and announced a 'great citizenship mutirão'. After the SCS visit, he proceeded to the Plano Piloto bus station, where he engaged with the public and joked with a local street artist.

item.title: Lula acena a Alcolumbre por PECs e defende soberania em terras raras
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva thanked Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for forwarding three government priorities: the Public Security PEC, the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, and the bill on critical and strategic minerals, including rare earths. Lula stressed national sovereignty over these resources, insisting Brazil must process and transform them domestically rather than merely export raw materials. The proposals were sent to Senate committees, though they had not yet appeared as officially assigned in the chamber’s tracking systems as of Monday afternoon.

item.title: Lula: País que tem petróleo desta qualidade não vai permitir que ninguém meta o dedo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva emphasized the strategic value of newly discovered oil in Brazil's Equatorial Margin as leverage against potential U.S. actions under Donald Trump to close the Strait of Hormuz, framing it as part of his re-election campaign narrative on energy sovereignty and criticism of Bolsonaro-era privatizations. He lamented the sale of BR Distribuidora (now Vibra Energia) and other refineries, arguing the Brazilian state lost from deregulation and expressing a desire to reverse these moves, while acknowledging contractual constraints preventing Petrobras from competing with Vibra until 2029. Lula also tied Petrobras' survival to investment in research and harshly criticized those behind the privatizations as incompetent, defending a strong state role in the fuel sector.

item.title: Moraes autoriza que Bolsonaro vá ao dentista, mas nega atendimento com mulher de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized dental treatment for former President Jair Bolsonaro but denied that it be performed by his daughter-in-law, dentist Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Moraes ruled the procedure must take place at the Military Police Medical Center under escort from the 19th Battalion for security reasons, with the date kept confidential and subject to cancellation if leaked.

item.title: PT não desistiu do apoio do Centrão no primeiro turno, mesmo com neutralidade dos principais partidos
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva said the party has not abandoned efforts to secure electoral support from Centrão parties in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, despite neutrality declarations from Progressistas, União Brasil, and Republicanos. He stated that dialogue will begin immediately following the official start of campaigning on Monday, emphasizing that 'no game is won without being played.' The PSD, while fielding its own candidate (Ronaldo Caiado), supports Lula in certain states such as Bahia and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Após cantoria e homenagem à Marisa, Janja viajará sem Lula na campanha
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva will travel to several municipalities without President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, as the PT leadership confirms Lula cannot visit all 5,569 municipalities. Janja has already been active in the campaign, leading the fight against femicide and addressing issues such as violence against women, animal rights, and social media. Her performance surprised party leaders after singing the campaign jingle and paying tribute to Lula’s late wife, Marisa Letícia, at an event in São Bernardo do Campo.

item.title: Quando o Estado busca a fonte, a democracia é o alvo
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court authorized a search and seizure operation against a man identified only as the source of reports that annoyed a minister of the Court, after previously seizing the equipment of the journalist who wrote the stories. The author warns that, although formally legal, this action threatens press freedom and the rule of law, repeating the historical pattern where exceptions meant to protect democracy end up destroying it by targeting its defenders. Journalistic sources, vital to democracy, are being treated as enemies, reversing the historical role such figures played in Brazil's redemocratization.

item.title: Governo Trump acusa Brasil de censura após rede social alterar algoritmo para eleições
item.description: The Trump administration accused Brazil of censorship after X (formerly Twitter) announced its 'Brazil2026ElectionFilter' algorithm, which stops recommending candidate accounts not followed by users during the 2026 elections, in compliance with a TSE ruling. X stated the change does not block direct access to content, only reduces its automated visibility. The accusation came from Deputy Secretary of State Sarah B. Rogers amid ongoing tensions between the platform and Brazilian authorities, including X’s suspension in Brazil in August 2024 by order of Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: “Futuro na Suíça”: O que revelam as mensagens de Lulinha
item.description: Messages exchanged between Lulinha and Roberta Luchsinger in March 2024 reveal a lobbying scheme within President Lula's office, involving alleged influence trafficking under investigation by the Federal Police. The conversations suggest efforts to secure political or economic advantages through proximity to power, raising concerns about improper use of influence. The case was highlighted on the Papo Antagonista program, fueling broader debates about ethics and transparency in the federal administration.

item.title: Possível entrada de Marçal na disputa eleitoral beneficia Flávio, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, claimed that Pablo Marçal’s (PRTB) potential entry into the 2026 electoral race is a maneuver designed to benefit Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). He argued that Marçal’s candidacy could split opposition voters or fragment the ideological opposition, indirectly or directly favoring the Bolsonaro-aligned candidate. The statement was made on August 17, 2026, at 5:52 PM.

item.title: Pablo Marçal diz que quer ir a debates e que não criará problema para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Pablo Marçal, PRTB presidential candidate, stated he intends to participate in electoral debates and will not create problems for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential bid. The remarks were made during an interview on Brazil Paralelo channel on Monday (17).

item.title: Governador do Maranhão diz que Dino não tem competência para julgá-lo
item.description: Maranhão Governor Carlos Brandão (MDB) and his legal team challenge the authority of Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino to lead investigations against him and his allies, arguing Dino is constitutionally incompetent due to his prior role as governor (2015–2022) and Brandão’s former vice, creating a conflict of interest. The defense claims the Federal Police investigations lack endorsement from the Attorney General’s Office and that Dino’s involvement undermines the validity of investigative measures, including the removal of Daniel Brandão, president of the State Audit Court, linked to the 'Tech Office' case involving embezzlement and obstruction of justice.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que Lula exerce liderança na ‘proteção da soberania nacional’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) praised President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for his leadership in protecting national sovereignty, particularly regarding oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin. He highlighted the significance of hydrocarbon discoveries at Petrobras' Morpho well and emphasized that government revenue from the sector transforms people's lives. Alcolumbre did not explicitly endorse Lula's re-election but stressed oil's strategic role in national development.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a passar por atendimento odontológico
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to leave house arrest for a dental appointment with dentist Fernanda Antunes Figueira Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The visit will be escorted by the Military Police Battalion and held at the Military Police Medical Center, with date and time kept confidential. This is Bolsonaro’s first leave since May 4, when he underwent a shoulder procedure.

item.title: Daniela Lima: Bolsonarismo focou em detratar Caiado após críticas a Flávio
item.description: The rise in rejection of Ronaldo Caiado was driven by the negative reaction from Bolsonarists to his criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro, according to columnist Daniela Lima on UOL News. Although Caiado is the PSD candidate, his critical stance toward the former president's son triggered a backlash from Bolsonaro supporters, damaging his image.

item.title: Flávio compartilha vídeo com informaçăo falsa sobre compras em mercado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shared an Instagram video containing false information about supermarket shopping, in which a woman claimed to have spent a lot of money on few products while omitting other purchased items. The content was used to criticize alleged high prices but represents misinformation about the cost of living.

item.title: Kassab: PSD năo é Centrăo e tem candidato próprio; Caiado é competitivo e tem equipe boa
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate, stated that the party is not part of the 'Centrão' and has its own candidate for the 2026 elections. He also praised Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado, calling him competitive and well-supported by a strong team.

item.title: Zema diz que quer enquadrar facções como terroristas e defende erguer presídio isolado na Amazônia
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for the Novo party, advocated classifying criminal factions as terrorists with 25-year sentences and no benefits, and proposed building an isolated prison in the Amazon. He also reiterated his four-pillar government plan: total privatization (including Cemig), Administrative Reform, Pension Reform, and social program review, while advocating for lowering the Selic rate to 6% and implementing spending cuts larger than those under Temer.

item.title: Kassab diz que campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro está preocupada com Caiado: ‘Jogo político’
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, running mate for Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) presidential ticket, said Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign is 'worried' about Caiado's rising popularity, calling it a sign of strength for their candidacy. He noted that the withdrawal of support from the 'Centrão' bloc from Bolsonaro has freed up television time that now benefits Caiado, and assessed Bolsonaro's chances of winning as 'zero'. Kassab emphasized that the PSD nominated Caiado to avoid a potential Lula vs. Bolsonaro runoff.

item.title: Em reaproximação, Alcolumbre exalta Lula: “Enfrentou tudo e todos”
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) publicly praised President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) during a visit to a Petrobras research vessel in Oiapoque (AP), stating that Lula 'faced everything and everyone' to advance the Margem Equatorial oil exploration project. The remarks mark the first joint public appearance between the two since the restoration of dialogue following tensions over the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. Alcolumbre, who aims to run again for Senate presidency in 2027, used the occasion to strengthen institutional rapprochement with the government.

item.title: Nunes Marques convida países a conhecerem “confiabilidade das eleições”
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques invited representatives from 88 countries to observe Brazil's 2026 elections, emphasizing the reliability and transparency of the electoral system. The event featured presentations on electronic voting machines, electoral technology, disinformation, and artificial intelligence, with specific concerns raised about deepfakes and voice cloning targeting candidates. The United States also sent representatives, underscoring international interest in Brazil's democratic process.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja quem são os 13 candidatos à Presidência que pediram registro de candidatura ao TSE
item.description: Thirteen candidates have filed to run for President in the 2026 elections, including Lula (PT) seeking a fourth term, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), and others from parties such as Novo, PCB, PSTU, and UP. The TSE is now reviewing documentation to validate registrations, while campaigning has officially begun with permitted street and online advertising.

item.title: Meta descumpre regra eleitoral e recomenda perfis de candidatos
item.description: Meta is failing to comply with TSE resolution prohibiting social media platforms from recommending official candidate profiles during the electoral period, with Instagram and Facebook showing candidate content to users who do not follow them. The rule, updated in 2024, bans algorithms from ranking, recommending, or prioritizing political campaigns except for paid promotion. X (formerly Twitter) has already adjusted its algorithm to comply, while Meta continues to violate Brazilian electoral law.

item.title: TSE lança campanha para estimular participação nas eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched the 'Elections 2026 – Coisa de Pele' campaign to encourage voter participation in the October 2026 general elections. Led by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, the initiative positions the voter as the protagonist of democracy, using cultural elements like Jorge Aragão’s music to promote inclusivity, diversity, and voter education on voting procedures and ballot justification. The videos and audio spots are now available on TSE’s social media profiles.

item.title: Campanha “Eleições 2026” do TSE estimula participação do eleitor
item.description: The TSE launched the 'Elections 2026 – Coisa de Pele' campaign to stimulate voter participation, emphasizing conscious voting and cultural diversity as pillars of democracy. The first round is scheduled for October 4, with a potential second round on October 25, supported by videos and audio spots shared on the tribunal’s official social media profiles.

item.title: Petrobras confirma petróleo na Foz do Amazonas; veja o que descoberta significa para o Brasil
item.description: Petrobras confirmed the presence of oil in the Morpho well, located in the Foz do Amazonas Basin off the coast of Amapá, marking a significant step in the exploration of Brazil’s Equatorial Margin. However, the company emphasized that the discovery does not yet confirm a commercially viable field, as further drilling, reservoir analysis, and recoverable volume estimates are still required. Petrobras plans additional wells in the area to assess the region’s long-term production potential.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro estende estadia em MG e fará ato com Nikolas nesta 3ª
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) extended his stay in Belo Horizonte until Tuesday morning (08/18) after canceling events in Juiz de Fora due to bad weather. He will participate in a sticker campaign and press conference with federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL), as well as the launch of Flávio Roscoe's campaign — a candidate Bolsonaro endorsed for a legislative seat in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Marqueteiro deixa campanha de Caiado após divergências
item.description: Mineiro strategist Paulo Vasconcelos left the presidential campaign of Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) due to disagreements over electoral strategy. Allies stated that Vasconcelos favored an approach based on Caiado’s gubernatorial record in Goiás, while the candidate pursued a different direction. His departure occurred early in the year, shortly after being appointed to lead the campaign’s marketing efforts.

item.title: ‘Os americanos não vão resolver um problema que é nosso’, diz Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, said the U.S. should not solve Brazil's security issues, particularly regarding PCC and Comando Vermelho, and advocated for a joint police force with neighboring countries to improve cooperation. He also criticized Finance Minister Dario Durigan, claiming the Lula government presents an overly optimistic economic outlook disconnected from reality, citing Casas Bahia's judicial recovery and excessive public spending beyond the fiscal framework.

item.title: Renan diz que candidatura de Marçal beneficia Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, said Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) candidacy benefits Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), acting as a 'folkloric figure' to distract and favor Bolsonaro clan interests. He described Marçal's entry as expected and part of a larger political strategy.

item.title: Justiça derruba vídeo em que Lucas Pavanato ataca Erika Hilton
item.description: São Paulo's Electoral Justice ordered the removal of a campaign video by councilman Lucas Pavanato (PL) that falsely accused federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSOL) of using public funds to hire makeup artists and attacked her gender identity. The decision followed a preliminary injunction by Hilton's legal team, which provided evidence from the Chamber of Deputies disproving the claims. Social media platforms were required to take down the video within 24 hours, and Pavanato was barred from reposting it under threat of a daily fine of R$ 1,000, capped at R$ 50,000.

item.title: "Fomos pegos de surpresa", diz chefe do União-SP sobre saída de Marçal
item.description: Milton Leite, president of União Brasil in São Paulo, said the party was caught off guard by Pablo Marçal's decision to return to PRTB after obtaining a retroactive injunction that restored his affiliation and allowed him to register a presidential candidacy, despite being ineligible until 2032. The party had been working to reverse his legal situation and hoped to nominate him as a federal or state deputy as a vote-getter. Leite said he respects Marçal's choice and will wait for further developments.
